policy: User-authorized, explicitly labelled valuation proxies for incompletely disclosed debt components. Reported facts remain separate. Stress ranges are chosen scenarios, not confidence intervals or proven bounds.
unitPolicy: Money in reporting-currency millions; shares in millions; per-share sensitivities hold operations, cash, other claims and share count fixed. More debt lowers per-share equity value dollar for dollar before any equity floor.

knownBorrowings.locator: Q3 US GAAP balance sheet, long-term debt

proxyComponents.method: June current + June noncurrent − Q3 debt/finance-lease repayments − September noncurrent; cash movements are an approximation for carrying-value changes
proxyComponents.locator: June statutory interim report p.14 borrowings; Q3 US GAAP statements pp.4–5 debt and repayments
proxyComponents.accountingCaveat: June current debt is from EU-IFRS interim statements. Annual current borrowing1,681.9 and June noncurrent1,984.4 reconcile to US-GAAP borrowing disclosures; using the June current balance remains a labelled cross-basis proxy.

sensitivity.rangeBasis: Current borrowings zero through last reported June amount1,735.3; finance leases zero through twice16.5. Chosen stresses, not guaranteed bounds.

ASML-TTM-2026-09-27.note: Debt uses an explicitly estimated cash-flow bridge: June borrowings of €3,719.7 million plus €16.5 million of carried finance leases, less €1,000.4 million of Q3 repayments, gives €2,735.8 million. Hedge, currency and amortization changes are not reconciled. Testing current debt from zero to the June balance and leases from zero to twice the annual balance changes value by +€2.01/−€2.59 per share. The June share count and annual awards remain carried estimates.
ASML-TTM-2026-09-27.noteZh: 债务使用明确标注的现金流估算：6月借款37.197亿欧元，加上沿用的融资租赁负债0.165亿欧元，再减去第三季度偿还额10.004亿欧元，得到27.358亿欧元。对冲、汇率及摊销变化尚未调节。将流动债务设为零至6月余额、租赁负债设为零至年度余额的两倍，每股估值变动为增加2.01或减少2.59欧元。股数仍沿用6月数据，奖励股数仍沿用年度数据。
